name: personal
description: Personal agent skill library — pre-plan, plan, audit, review, release.

plugins.name: intake
plugins.description: Pre-planning ticket ingestion. Reads a ticket via MCP or CLI, follows all references in parallel subagents, synthesises a context brief, clarifies ambiguities, then hands off to /atdd-plan.

plugins.name: research-catalog
plugins.description: Whenever you do external research (WebFetch, WebSearch, Explore-agent fetches of URLs outside the repo), catalog it under docs/research/ in the consuming project before sending the synthesis back to the user. Credits sources by name/URL/type, captures findings, and creates a traceable link from the decision back to the evidence.

plugins.name: atdd-plan
plugins.description: ATDD-first implementation planning with named design patterns, SOLID audit, and Kent Dodds Testing Trophy. Use when planning any feature, fix, or refactor.

plugins.name: staleness-audit
plugins.description: Pre-commit audit. Diffs staged changes against the repo's canary files (README, decision log, roadmap, public entry point, doc comments, release notes, test names) and surfaces drift before it lands in history.

plugins.name: implementation-review
plugins.description: Pre-commit quality gate. Six checks: plan gaps, use-case coverage, missing test scenarios, test philosophy (Kent Dodds Testing Trophy), SOLID violations, Clean Code violations.

plugins.name: release-check
plugins.description: Post-commit gate. Detects the project's release mechanism, checks whether a release is due, and proposes a semver bump with a Valve Dota-style value-focused CHANGELOG entry.

plugins.name: write-docs
plugins.description: Write documentation that reads like a person wrote it for another person. Teaches the craft (curse of knowledge, classic style, voice vs tone, context where it lands not in a glossary, prose where causality matters) before the conventions (Diátaxis modes, README landing-page arc). Built on Pinker, Heath brothers, Mailchimp, and the celebrated landing pages of React, Stripe, Anthropic, SpacetimeDB, Tokio.
